notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, impersonate=chrome) succeeded for every page fetched - robots.txt has no anthropic/Claude-specific disallow and no blanket User-agent:* Disallow:/, so no tier restriction applied; site returned full SSR HTML with an embedded JSON facet blob containing totalResults per listing, so tier (b)/(c) were never needed. TREE: union of homepage mega-menu (all nav sections/groups read from w86_home.html) + /sitemap.xml (709 URLs) + each candidate page's own sub-nav; h1/title checked on every candidate leaf to confirm it matched the requested node (no bad-slug silent-wrong-number cases found). QTY: read exact totalResults:<N> field from each page's embedded facet JSON (data-filtered attribute), never estimated. EXCLUDED as Furniture (already in validated Furniture.xlsx / furniture domain): all-sofas*, all-chairs*, all-beds* incl. all-beds/storage-beds (Divan and storage beds), all-headboards*, all-footstools* incl. all-footstools/storage-footstools (footstool w/ storage = furniture subtype, not broken out separately in Furniture.xlsx either), sitting-room-furniture/*, kitchen-furniture/*, bedroom-furniture/* incl. bedroom-furniture/ottomans-storage-boxes (already recorded as Furniture qty 5). EXCLUDED as neither Textile nor Storage: all-kitchen-tableware/mugs, trays, mirrors, all-homewares/dog-beds (pet), all-cosy-accessories/hot-water-bottles (primary product = hot water bottle, not a textile/fabric product; verified 2 products are huggins-hot-water-bottle and shearer-hottie-hot-water-bottle), all-lighting/*, swatches (free fabric-sample ordering flow, not a shoppable product category), all seasonal/color/promo collection pages (christmas/*, sofas-chairs/<color>, bag-a-bargain-all, sample-sale, new-arrivals, shearling-collection, neutral, mid-century, sleepover-collection, brilliant-blues, cosy-comfort) per View-All/Collection URL rule, and every *-old / BIN/* sitemap path (deprecated, unlinked from current nav; all-kitchen-tableware-old/table-kitchen-linens explicitly shows totalResults:0 and all-cushions-old/scatter-cushions duplicates content already captured under all-cushions). EXCLUDED redundant aggregator parents (verified by product-link-set comparison that the parent page's listing is a pure/near-pure union of its own named subcategories, so parent URL dropped per textile.md #25 / storage.md #34): all-rugs (27 items, product set is a strict subset of floor-rugs+runners union - no unique content), bedding-bed-linen (23 items = exact union of bed-linen 13 + duvets-pillows 10), all-cosy-accessories/blankets-quilts (10 items = exact union of blankets 6 + quilts 4), and /bedding (byte-identical duplicate/alias of bedding-bed-linen/duvets-pillows - same h1, same totalResults, same page size - dropped as duplicate per rule #30). KEPT all-cushions (17) as its own row alongside its two named subcategories (seat-pads, beanbags-floor-cushions) because product-link comparison showed only 4 of its 17 items are covered by those subcategories - the remaining 13 are general/scatter cushions with no other listing page, so dropping the parent would silently lose legitimate Textile products; this is the one case where parent+children are both recorded. Beanbags and Floor Cushions marked LOW confidence: floor cushions are unambiguously Textile per rules, but beanbags read as closer to a soft-seating furniture item; site bundles both under one Cushions/Soft-furnishings nav link with no separate URL, so recorded as a single row per the site's own hierarchy. Seat Pads marked MEDIUM: not literally named in textile.md's list but functionally equivalent to the ruleset's included 'Seat Cushions/Chair Cushions'. Bath Towels (sitemap-only URL, not present in the current mega-menu) kept with qty 0 per storage/textile zero-product rule - its facet JSON explicitly shows totalResults:0 with listingIsFiltered:false (not a filter artifact), flagged for review since it is orphaned from live nav. Underbed Storage (sitemap-only URL 'underbed-storage-new', not in current mega-menu) kept with qty 2 per its own totalResults field, flagged as sitemap-only. No View-All/search/product-detail URLs used. No quantities aggregated or estimated.
